prose: Asked about local inference, Sam Altman argued that supply-constrained DRAM is better used in data centers than sitting in PCs 'being used 5% of the time' - Tom's Hardware headlines the exchange as OpenAI's CEO saying it is 'quite terrible for your PC to have RAM.' The cached page is the site's membership wall, so the quotes come from the feed's report of the piece; the argument lands as memory prices surge on AI demand.
highlights: Altman: scarce DRAM is better used in data centers than in PCs 'being used 5% of the time'
Tom's Hardware: 'quite terrible for your PC to have RAM'
Lands amid an AI-driven surge in memory prices
basis: Techmeme summary of the Tom's Hardware piece; cached page is a membership wall
